scripts.verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && turbo build test && pnpm --filter @shortround/core test:node-import && pnpm test:release && pnpm --filter @shortround/catalog types:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter @shortround/storybook build:storybook
scripts.yalc:clean: pnpm -F examples/todo-app exec yalc remove --all && pnpm -F examples/todo-app install
scripts.yalc:push: chokidar "packages/*/dist/**/*" -c "cd packages/shortround-core && yalc publish --push --no-scripts && cd ../shortround-mui && yalc publish --push --no-scripts"
scripts.dev:yalc: pnpm run yalc:clean && concurrently "pnpm run dev:watch" "pnpm run yalc:push" "turbo dev"
